identityFindings: Two different oligometastatic consensus documents are carried in 15 (ESTRO-ASTRO via repub.eur.nl, PMID 32388150; ESTRO-EORTC, PMID 31908301): one is labelled 'primary full-consensus PDF'; neither is a primary study (C07).
36030639 is a survey and 33953240 an observational cohort; leaf 31 labels both primary (C07).
Source lists in 11 contain five URLs but three distinct papers (32245699=PMC7946408; PMC5961353=29635390=ddd.uab.cat PDF).

Leaf 10 attributes 'historical scars persist after HRR restoration' to Cruz 2018; raw Cruz text carries it as an Introduction sentence citing Watkins 2014 (Breast Cancer Res 16:211), a review not resolved here.
Leaf 23's benign-myoepithelial statement is the abstract's background, not a result of 23260325.

primaryEvidenceObservedForRetainedEscala.observation: CAP 1.6.2.0 raw: 0 = no membrane staining; 0+ = incomplete faint/barely perceptible <=10% tumor cells; 1+ same pattern >10%; 2+ weak-moderate complete >10%; 3+ complete intense >10% homogeneous contiguous. Matches the SVG text; SVG pixels, integrated-status and eligibility sentences and expert review not done
CAP 4.11 raw: micrometastasis >0.2-2 mm; only-micrometastasis sets are pN1mi; macrometastasis-containing 1-3 node set is pN1a. Consistent with SVG cases A/B; ITC counting separately defined
CAP 4.11 raw: ENE measurement perpendicular to capsule or otherwise, no evidence for a specific method, reporting extent optional. Consistent with the 'no measurement direction' statement
32245699 abstract supports the paired 8-patient reversion/RAD51 statement; scar persistence is only secondary in Cruz; primary lead needed
